name: learn
example: I learn one word before breakfast.
exampleTranslation: 我在早餐前学一个单词。

name: remember
example: I remember the name of this bird.
exampleTranslation: 我记得这种鸟的名字。

name: review
example: We review five words after lunch.
exampleTranslation: 我们午饭后复习五个单词。

name: listen
example: Listen to the rain by the window.
exampleTranslation: 在窗边听听雨声。

name: write
example: Write your idea on this card.
exampleTranslation: 把你的想法写在这张卡片上。

name: read
example: I read a short story on the train.
exampleTranslation: 我在火车上读一个短篇故事。

name: speak
example: Please speak slowly for me.
exampleTranslation: 请对我说慢一点。

name: think
example: Think about your next small step.
exampleTranslation: 想想你接下来的小步骤。

name: repeat
example: Repeat the word after a short pause.
exampleTranslation: 稍停一下后重复这个单词。

name: practice
example: We practice English in the kitchen.
exampleTranslation: 我们在厨房里练习英语。

name: answer
example: You can answer in a full sentence.
exampleTranslation: 你可以用一个完整的句子回答。

name: question
example: I have a question about this word.
exampleTranslation: 关于这个单词我有一个问题。

name: meaning
example: The picture helps explain the meaning.
exampleTranslation: 这张图有助于解释这个含义。

name: sound
example: A soft sound came from the garden.
exampleTranslation: 花园里传来轻轻的声音。

name: letter
example: The last letter is hard to see.
exampleTranslation: 最后一个字母很难看清。

name: sentence
example: This sentence has only four words.
exampleTranslation: 这个句子只有四个单词。

name: story
example: Tell me a story about your cat.
exampleTranslation: 给我讲一个关于你的猫的故事。

name: page
example: There is a blue mark on this page.
exampleTranslation: 这一页上有一个蓝色标记。

name: book
example: My book is beside the green cup.
exampleTranslation: 我的书在绿色杯子旁边。

name: goal
example: My goal is to read a little each day.
exampleTranslation: 我的目标是每天读一点。
